technique_name: Generate heatmap visualization for the given dataset comparing the time spent studying for 3 different exams.
description:
<noinput>

This heatmap visualization compares the time spent studying for 3 different exams. Exam 1 is represented by the color green, Exam 2 by yellow, and Exam 3 by red. The darker the shading, the more time was spent studying for that exam. 

[Heatmap Visualisation] 
[Exam 1 - Green| Exam 2 - Yellow| Exam 3 - Red] 
 0 - 1 hours   |  0 - 1 hours  | 0 - 1 hours   
  1 - 2 hours  |  1 - 2 hours  |  1 - 2 hours   
  2 - 3 hours  |  2 - 3 hours  |  2 - 3 hours   
  3 - 4 hours  |  3 - 4 hours  |
example:
Exam 1: 3 hours
Exam 2: 5 hours
Exam 3: 6 hours
